stem: In paragraph 5, the examples of lost cities suggest that a major role of an archaeologist is to —

options.label: A
options.text: explain why real locations are mentioned in ancient literature

options.label: B
options.text: locate written accounts of powerful cities that no longer exist

options.label: C
options.text: create replicas of historical buildings based on satellite images

options.label: D
options.text: find clues that provide a better understanding of the past
